exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. elective cesarean section)
cohort: 2,507 primiparous women (1,807 with vaginal deliveries and 700 with elective cesarean deliveries)
finding: In primiparous women, elective cesarean section did not present a higher risk of complications compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section did not have a higher risk of complications compared to vaginal delivery in primiparous women.
gest_age: 39 weeks and above for elective Cesarean section
